title: VaSto: Benedetto Varchi, Storia fiorentina (genetic and annotated digital edition)
author: Benedetto Varchi
institution: DH.ARC, Università di Bologna, with Concordia University (Montréal) and CarisBo
notes: Digital genetic and annotated edition (EVT2) of Varchi's unfinished Storia fiorentina, left incomplete at his death in 1565 and printed only in 1721 in a censored form. The site offers diplomatic and critical views with facsimile. Only the Proemio is published so far: the TEI file pilot_proemio.xml in the project's GitHub repository holds about 3,900 words (our own count of the body text); the whole work is not online. Status archived: the repository's last commit is 13 June 2021 and the site has had no update since. The licence is the Creative Commons BY-NC-ND 3.0 link shown on the home page.
